intro: Gamma crossed $100M in annual recurring revenue in November 2025 — profitably, with roughly 50 employees and no sales team. Every reported ARR, valuation and user number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

milestones.note: Crosses $100M ARR, profitably, with ~50 employees; raises $68M Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $2.1B valuation.
User base grows past 70M, with reports of ~100M; an API release opens generation to third-party products.

modelParagraphs: Gamma runs a classic freemium consumer-SaaS model. The free tier grants a limited number of AI generation credits, which acts as the top of the funnel for its 70M+ users; paid plans start around $10/month (Plus) and step up to roughly $20/month per user (Pro), with credits metered on top for heavy generation. Students, creators and small teams make up most of the base — revenue is dominated by self-serve card payments, not contracts.

Because acquisition is product-led and organic, Gamma reached $100M ARR with ~50 employees, no sales team and two-plus years of profitability — roughly $2M of ARR per employee. The November 2025 API release adds a second motion: third-party products paying to embed Gamma's document-generation engine.
revenueMix: Plus ~$10/month and Pro ~$20/month, self-serve checkout only.
Metered credit packs billed on top of plan allowances.
New in late 2025: generation embedded in third-party products.

faqs.a: Gamma crossed $100 million in annual recurring revenue in November 2025, announced by founder Grant Lee alongside a $68M Series B. The company was profitable at the time, with roughly 50 employees.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Gamma Reach $100M ARR?
faqs.a: About five years from founding (2020) and roughly three years from launch. ARR went from ~$20M in late 2024 to $100M by November 2025 — most of the growth compressed into the final twelve months.

Freemium subscriptions and AI credits. A free tier with limited credits feeds paid plans from about $10/month to roughly $20/month per user, with metered credit packs on top. A late-2025 API release opened a second, usage-based revenue line.

faqs.q: What Is Gamma's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: A $68 million Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz in November 2025 valued Gamma at $2.1 billion. Total funding is around $87 million across three rounds.

faqs.q: How Efficient Is Gamma as a Business?
faqs.a: Extremely. ~$100M of ARR on ~50 employees is roughly $2M of ARR per employee, achieved with no sales team and two-plus years of profitability — among the best ratios in software.
